info.title: APITube News API
info.summary: Search and filter news articles from thousands of sources worldwide.
info.description:
APITube News API provides programmatic access to a comprehensive, real-time news database aggregated from thousands of sources worldwide. Use it to search, filter, and retrieve news articles with advanced query capabilities.

## Key Endpoints

- **Everything** (`/v1/news/everything`) — full-text search across all indexed articles with filters by title, date range, language, country, source, sentiment, category, topic, industry, and named entities (people, organizations, locations, brands, etc.).
- **Top Headlines** (`/v1/news/top-headlines`) — breaking and trending news from high-authority sources ranked by OPR score.
- **Story** (`/v1/news/story/{articleId}`) — retrieve related articles for a given story.
- **Article** (`/v1/news/article`) — fetch one or more articles by ID.
- **Dictionaries** — list available categories, topics, industries, and entities.
- **Trends** — discover trending topics and entities over time.
- **Stream** (`/v1/news/stream`) — real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream of new articles.
- **Webhooks** — subscribe to push notifications for new articles matching your filters.

## Export Formats

JSON (default), CSV, TSV, XML, RSS, XLSX, Parquet, JSONL, and NDJSON.

## Authentication

All requests require an API key passed via the `X-API-Key` header or the `api_key` query parameter.

post.description: Search and filter news articles from thousands of sources worldwide. Supports advanced filtering by title, date, language, source, category, topic, industry, entity, sentiment, readability, media, location, and more. Results can be exported in multiple formats (CSV, TSV, XML, RSS, XLSX, Parquet, JSONL).

prompt.description: Plain-language description of the news you want, e.g. "Elon Musk, Tesla, news for the last 10 days". It is translated into the regular filters below before the search runs, and the resulting parameters are returned in meta.prompt. Explicit parameters always win over the prompt. Costs 2 extra points when the wording has not been parsed before (repeats are served from cache). Available on Basic and above — on Free and Starter the request fails with 403 ER0706. Errors: ER0706 (plan), ER0800 (length), ER0801 (translation service unavailable), ER0802 (nothing usable in the prompt).

post.description: Returns raw articles straight from the discovery stage, before HTML parsing and NLP enrichment. This is a fast-churning staging feed (rows are continuously consumed by the pipeline and expire within ~1 day). Enrichment fields (language, categories, topics, entities, sentiment, etc.) are not available at this stage. Supports pagination, source filtering, a published date range, and basic sorting.

post.description: Verifies factual claims against APITube’s live news corpus (retrieval-augmented). Accepts an article `id` (loaded from the corpus), raw article `text`, or a single `claim`. Returns per-claim verdicts on an 8-level scale with calibrated confidence, an explanation, and the supporting/refuting evidence articles.

post.description: Returns news articles whose mentioned locations fall within `radius` km of `lat`/`lng`, sorted by proximity. Each article is enriched with `distance_km` and `nearest_location`. Supports the same filters as `/v1/news/everything`. Optionally returns a `local_insights` dashboard (mood, hotspots, extracted events, top entities, media-bias split, top sources, timeline) via the `insights` parameter. Costs 1 point + 1 per requested insight block.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center (required unless `place` is given)

lng.description: Longitude of the search center (required unless `place` is given)

place.description: Place name to geocode into the search center instead of lat/lng (e.g. `Berlin`). Resolved heuristically against the entity graph; ambiguous names are matched to the best candidate — add `country` or pass `lat`/`lng` for precision. Explicit lat/lng take precedence over `place`.

sort.description: Sort order: nearest first (`distance`), newest first (`published_at`), or `relevance` (blends proximity + source authority + recency + breaking; adds `relevance_score` to each article)

ranking.description: Relevance weighting preset (only when sort=relevance): balanced, proximity (closer wins), authority (bigger sources win), fresh (recency wins). Override individual weights with w.* params.

w.opr.description: Relevance weight for source authority (overrides preset)

insights.description: Comma-separated local intelligence blocks to compute over the radius. Values: mood, hotspots, events, entities, bias, sources, timeline, top_categories, top_topics, breaking, velocity, movers. `velocity`/`movers` use rolling time windows and are most accurate without an explicit published_at filter. Each block costs 1 additional point.

title_pattern.description: Filter articles whose title matches the given pattern. Same 31-day window limit as title

published_at.description: Exact date (creates 24-hour range). Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601

published_at.start.description: Start of date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Combined with a title search the range may not exceed 31 days (ER0110)

published_at.end.description: End of date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601. Combined with a title search the range may not exceed 31 days (ER0110)

ignore.language.code.description: Exclude articles in these languages (comma-separated, max 3)

source.country.code.description: Filter by source country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.source.country.code.description: Exclude sources from these countries (comma-separated, max 3)

source.bias.description: Filter by media bias (comma-separated). Values: left, center, right

ignore.source.bias.description: Exclude sources with this media bias (comma-separated). Values: left, center, right

entity.sentiment.polarity.description: Filter by sentiment polarity toward the entity (combine with entity.id or *.name; standalone = any entity)

entity.sentiment.score.min.description: Minimum sentiment score toward the entity

entity.sentiment.score.max.description: Maximum sentiment score toward the entity

ignore.person.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these persons (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.organization.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these organizations (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.location.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these locations (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.brand.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these brands (comma-separated, max 3)

disaster.name.description: Filter by natural disaster name (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.disaster.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these disasters (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.disease.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these diseases (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.event.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these events (comma-separated, max 3)

ignore.sport.name.description: Exclude articles mentioning these sports (comma-separated, max 3)

event.type.description: Comma-separated event types (max 5). Values: merger-acquisition, ipo, layoffs, bankruptcy, product-launch, funding-round, earnings, partnership, executive-change, lawsuit, data-breach, recall, expansion, closure, stock-movement, contract-award, spin-off, regulatory-action, election, protest, crime, terrorism, accident, policy-change, scandal, death, award-ceremony, conflict, diplomacy, health-crisis, migration, human-rights, earthquake, hurricane, flood, wildfire, tornado, tsunami, volcanic-eruption, drought, climate-event, pollution, wildlife-event, avalanche

sentiment.mixed.description: Filter for mixed sentiment (title polarity != body polarity)

sentiment.consistent.description: Filter for consistent sentiment (title polarity == body polarity)

sentiment_gap.min.description: Minimum sentiment gap between title and body

sentiment_gap.max.description: Maximum sentiment gap between title and body

has_hq_images.description: Filter articles with high-quality images (>= 1200px width)

is_media_rich.description: Filter articles with both images and videos

has_fullhd_images.description: Filter articles with Full HD images (>= 1920px width)

has_mobile_optimized_images.description: Filter articles with mobile-optimized images (320-800px width)

is_instagram_ready.description: Filter articles with Instagram-ready images (>= 1080px + aspect ratio)

is_twitter_card_ready.description: Filter articles with Twitter Card-ready images (>= 800px + landscape)

has_consistent_image_sizes.description: Filter articles with consistent image dimensions

has_thumbnail.description: Filter articles with thumbnail images (<= 300px width)

has_social_share_image.description: Filter articles with social share images (>= 1200x630px)

has_mixed_media.description: Filter articles with both image and video media types

is_easy_read.description: Filter for easy-to-read articles (Flesch Reading Ease >= 60)

is_difficult_read.description: Filter for difficult-to-read articles (Flesch Reading Ease < 40)

location.radius.description: Search radius in kilometers (requires location.lat and location.lng)

location.radius.min.description: Minimum distance from point in km

is_duplicate.description: Filter duplicate/unique articles

is_high_quality.description: Filter high-quality articles (not duplicate, rank >= 5, has images, has author)

ignore.author.name.description: Exclude articles by these authors (comma-separated, max 3)

facet.field.description: Comma-separated facet fields (max 5). Values: source.id, source.country.id, source.bias, language.id, author.id, category.id, topic.id, industry.id, entity.id, sentiment.overall.polarity, sentiment.title.polarity, sentiment.body.polarity, sentiment.strength, is_duplicate, is_free, is_important, media.images.count, media.videos.count, read_time, content.length, published.year, published.month, published.day_of_week, published.hour, published.weekday, published.time_of_day

facet.limit.description: Maximum number of facet values per field (max 100)

facet.mincount.description: Minimum count for a facet value to be included

facet.range.field.description: Field for range faceting. Values: published_at, sentiment.overall.score, sentiment.title.score, sentiment.body.score, read_time, source.rank.opr, media.images.count, media.videos.count

facet.range.start.description: Start value for range faceting (required with facet.range)

facet.range.end.description: End value for range faceting (required with facet.range)

hl.fl.description: Comma-separated fields to highlight (max 5). Values: title, description, body

hl.fragsize.description: Size of highlighted fragment in characters (50-500)

hl.snippets.description: Number of highlighted snippets per field (max 10)

fl.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response

debug.description: Include user_input in response for debugging

200.description: Successful response with matching article count

schema.description: Successful response with matching article count

count.description: Number of articles matching the filters
